gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve the current UI modifications applied to my Jira project so that I can review the changes made.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of UI modifications, including their IDs, types, and descriptions.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to create a new UI modification for our Jira instance to enhance user experience based on feedback.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the modification details and return the created modification's ID and confirmation of success.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete a specific UI modification that is no longer needed to keep the interface clean.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified UI modification and return a success message.

gold.user: As a UI designer, I want to update an existing UI modification to reflect the latest design changes based on user feedback.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated modification details and return the updated modification's information.
